The SORA Parliament will replace the current Governance V1 system, implementing sortition-based democracy where citizens are randomly selected (not token voting) and must post XOR bonds for citizenship. index.definition: The current governance system used by SORA v2, also known as Polkadot v1 Governance. Governance V1 consists of a Council, Technical Committee, and Parliament with on-chain proposals, referenda, and staking-based voting.
